crossRefs.note: He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn’t know what to answer him.
He came the third time, and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold…

translations.web: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,
translations.bsb: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
translations.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
translations.asv: And when he rose up from his prayer, he came unto the disciples, and found them sleeping for sorrow,
